description: Guide a student to implement and compare risk management models in LEAN's Algorithm Framework. The student must build a framework algorithm with EMA-based alpha on hourly data, then run three configurations: (1) no risk management, (2) built-in models (MaximumDrawdownPerSecurity + TrailingStop), (3) a custom RiskManagementModel that limits total portfolio exposure. The student compares drawdown and performance across all three runs, demonstrating understanding of the risk management pipeline stage.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I want to add risk controls to my LEAN framework algorithm — like automatic stop-losses and position limits. I also want to see how much difference it makes compared to having no risk management. How do I set this up?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I'm implementing risk management in LEAN's Algorithm Framework. I want to compare three configurations: no risk management, built-in models (MaximumDrawdownPerSecurity + TrailingStop), and a custom RiskManagementModel. How should I structure the comparison using GetParameter()?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I need to implement a custom RiskManagementModel (total exposure cap at 40%) alongside built-in risk models, compare three risk configurations via parameterized runs on hourly EMA alpha, and analyze the drawdown impact across configs. Architecture?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student produces (1) a LEAN framework algorithm with EMA(24)/EMA(72) hourly alpha, (2) three risk configurations selectable via GetParameter('risk_config'): none, builtin (MaximumDrawdownPerSecurity + TrailingStop), custom (MaxGroupExposureRiskManagementModel + TrailingStop), (3) a custom RiskManagementModel class inheriting from RiskManagementModel with ManageRisk() method, (4) three result sets showing drawdown improvement with risk management enabled, (5) a structured comparison output.
required_capabilities: Implement a framework algorithm with hourly resolution alpha model
Use built-in risk management models (MaximumDrawdownPerSecurity, TrailingStopRiskManagementModel)
Implement a custom RiskManagementModel class with ManageRisk() method
Use GetParameter() to switch risk configurations between runs
Compare performance across three risk configurations and analyze drawdown impact
